propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, leaking orphaned reverse keys if forward entries are destroyed through other code paths.
No supported API surface exists to clean up orphaned reverse entries, causing binding-drift canary alerts to remain permanently non-zero and mask genuine future integrity problems.
Concurrent merge conflicts using merge=ours strategy can drop forward entries wholesale without corresponding reverse pop, producing persistent orphaned reverse keys.
The fix makes unbind() self-contained by unconditionally sweeping the reverse index for any residual keys pointing to the local_id, regardless of forward entry contents.
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair verb prunes orphaned reverse entries via BindingStore.unbind() and enforces four pre-write guards to prevent invalid deletions.
